note: Shinhan Bank's product explanation for its SOL-pyeonhan demand deposit account (the edition it hosts, reviewed for 12 October 2024 to 11 October 2025): it names no fee for keeping the account, and waives transfer fees to other banks, its own ATMs' withdrawal fees and automatic-transfer fees; only a passbook reissue is charged, not modelled.
